summary.text: Bobbi Boudman is the Democratic candidate for New Hampshire State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Mark McConkey.
She is a state representative for Carroll 7, elected in a March 2026 special election.

paragraphs.text: Boudman graduated from Holyoke High School, earned an associate degree from Glendale Community College in 1998 and a bachelor's degree from Occidental College in 2000, and received a graduate degree from California State University, Northridge in 2008.

Her career experience includes working in the outdoor, music, and banking industries, founding a company called Babes in Backpacks, and serving as director for the Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks.

Boudman has also served as an athletic director in Alron, an office administrator for the Wentworth Watershed Association, and a substitute teacher in the Governor Wentworth Regional School District, and has worked for the Wolfeboro Area Creative Art Center and served on the Town of Wolfeboro budget committee.
She won a special general election for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 7, on March 10, 2026, and assumed office on March 25, 2026.
